title: Hemomancy
subtitle: The blood remembers
text: Hemomancy is the awakening and direction of power latent within blood - power seeded into living things by a vast, ancient organism over the course of centuries. The first signs are rarely grand: gourd seeds in common grass, iron that reddens after a wound, old temples with a Mortal Display still beating in the dark. Follow these signs carefully. The Blood Temple awakens the blood-memory; the Liber preserves what the Order learned after listening too long.
